options.subject: candidate landing
options.action: Merge PR #15 into the default branch
options.gate: cross-model verifier PASS, then a fresh live read of mergeable/mergeable_state
options.why: 31 files, purely additive (+6837/-0), mergeable clean, and its blobs were read back byte for byte when it was published. It has been waiting only for a maintainer act.

options.subject: candidate landing
options.action: Merge PR #16 into the default branch
options.gate: cross-model verifier PASS; HOLD and re-read if mergeable is unknown rather than retrying blind
options.why: It puts the corrected homepage on the default branch. Its one real blocker was found and repaired this round: the published copy used CRLF line endings where the repository is LF-only, so the homepage diff rewrote all 72 lines (+149/-72) and the 'otherwise unchanged' claim was false. The repaired blob is +77/-0 and the homepage diff is now purely additive.

options.subject: defect repair
options.action: Rebuild the homepage blobs with the repository's line convention
options.gate: opcode check: the rebuilt text must produce insert-only diffs against the default branch
options.why: A merge that rewrites every line of the front page is not a reviewable change, whatever the text says. Detected by reading the pull request's own diff, not by trusting the earlier claim.

options.subject: owner deferral
options.action: Issue a one-page owner bulletin for the 14 items whose kind is OWNER_DECISION
options.gate: the bulletin may prepare and rank; it may not sign, accept or claim
options.why: Fourteen items are waiting on a human. The useful engineering act is to shrink each to one minimal action form with the prerequisite already prepared, so the owner's cost is a decision rather than an investigation.

options.subject: skill candidate
options.action: Measure the installed skill surface and state which skill items are landable without a signature
options.gate: measurement only: inventory, entry-map five-point status, loader smoke cases listed but not claimed as accepted
options.why: The honest answer to 'which skills are practically landable' starts with what is installed and what its loader actually selects, rather than with another skill file.

options.subject: skill hygiene
options.action: Consolidate the skill references that cover the same topic instead of adding more
options.gate: the skill linter's own sprawl report is the measure; fold the new note into the existing topical reference
options.why: The linter already reported 114 files under references/. Adding a file per round is the drift this round is supposed to stop, so the round folds its lesson into the existing reference and says so.

options.subject: owner deferral
options.action: Name the external actor each BLOCKED item needs
options.gate: no agent may close an item that needs a second OS identity, a signed certificate or an external oracle
options.why: These 14 items are not blocked by work; they are blocked by a party that is not in this session. Recording the party is the only honest act available.

options.subject: rejected
options.action: Add a LICENSE, add continuous integration, or set repository metadata
options.gate: unchanged from the previous round's ruling
options.why: A licence is a legal choice, a workflow would change how evidence is produced, and metadata is cosmetics. None of the three is this round's business, and each would look like progress.

options.subject: boundary
options.gate: a round never merges its own delivery
options.why: Merging the pack that certifies the merges would make the round its own approver. The two previously verified candidates are merged; this round's pack is left open for the owner.
